summary: Round 11 testing completed. All 12 backend tests passed. Guest cart persistence feature fully functional: /api/cart/compute (public) and /api/cart/merge (auth) endpoints work correctly. Frontend guest cart flow verified: add items as guest, view cart with prices, merge on login. Hero image updated to /images/hero-delivery.jpg, typo fixed to 'afro-caraïbéennes', /zones-livraison route removed, footer link removed. Leaflet z-index CSS fix verified in App.css.

cart_compute_endpoint.details: POST /api/cart/compute (no auth) returns enriched cart with product details, subtotal, minimum_reached, amount_to_minimum. Unknown product_ids silently skipped.

cart_merge_endpoint.details: POST /api/cart/merge (auth required) merges guest items into user cart. Quantities for duplicate product_ids are ADDED (not replaced). Returns fully enriched cart.

guest_add_to_cart.details: Guest can add products via quick-add popover. Items stored in localStorage.koya_guest_cart. Header cart icon shows non-zero euro total.

guest_cart_page.details: Guest cart page (/panier) displays items with prices, quantity +/- controls, 50€ minimum warning banner, and total calculation.

guest_checkout_redirect.details: Checkout button disabled when minimum not reached. When enabled, clicking routes to /checkout which (ProtectedRoute) redirects to /connexion.

cart_merge_on_login.details: Guest with items in localStorage -> login -> cart merged server-side -> localStorage.koya_guest_cart removed -> /panier shows merged cart.

hero_image_update.details: Home page hero uses /images/hero-delivery.jpg (warm delivery handoff photo). File exists at /app/frontend/public/images/hero-delivery.jpg.

typo_fix.details: Headline reads 'Les saveurs afro-caraïbéennes' (correct spelling with ï dieresis). No 'afro-caribéennes' occurrences found.

delivery_zone_page_removed.details: /zones-livraison redirects to / (fallback route). Footer does NOT contain 'Zones de livraison' link.

leaflet_zindex_fix.details: App.css contains '.leaflet-container { isolation: isolate; z-index: 0; }' to contain Leaflet's internal z-indexes so Dialogs appear on top.

seed_data_creation: Test order ORD-D4A2669D created for tracking page testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 11 guest cart persistence fully implemented: 1) POST /api/cart/compute (public) computes enriched cart from {items: [{product_id, quantity}]}. 2) POST /api/cart/merge (auth) merges guest items into user cart, ADDING quantities for duplicates. 3) CartContext.js uses localStorage key 'koya_guest_cart' and mergedRef to prevent double-merge. 4) CartPage.js removed !isAuthenticated guard so guests see their cart. 5) ProductCard.js and CataloguePage.js removed login-required guards from handleAddToCart. 6) AuthPage.js navigates to location.state.from.pathname after login (preserves /checkout intent). 7) Hero image at /images/hero-delivery.jpg. 8) Typo fixed: 'afro-caraïbéennes'. 9) /zones-livraison route and DeliveryZonePage.js removed. 10) Leaflet z-index fix in App.css.
